description: Team trillium is a solo entry by Graham Mefford, Duke ‘30 (Economics + Mathematics). For the Earth System Trend Detective challenge, I use NASA MERRA-2 reanalysis to measure 45 years of 2 m air temperature change over the Southeast US (1980 to 2025). Monthly and annual series feed a linear trend per decade, tested for statistical significance, so real warming is separated from year-to-year noise. It brings quant-style rigor to Earth data, distilled into figures anyone can read in seconds.
